# Alp Serkan Merkit

> Mechanical engineer (B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering, Yaşar University, 2026; İzmir, Türkiye) who builds with AI: generative-design hardware, ESP32 devices, and AI-agent-built software held to automated quality gates. Open to engineering roles and an M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence.

Handle everywhere: `alpserkanmerkit`. Contact: alpserkanmer@outlook.com. A schema.org Person block (JSON-LD, `@id` https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/#person) is on the home page; each track page is a WebPage authored by that Person.

Machine-readable profile: [resume.json](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/resume.json) (JSON Resume v1).

## Pages

- [Home](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/): positioning, three tracks ([#doors](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/#doors)), six numbers with their sources ([#proof](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/#proof): 16 wheels · 0.086 kg · safety factor 2.3 · 33 wiring steps · 45 → 14 · 100%), education and three engineering internships (Katmerciler 2025 and 2024, Elektral 2023; [#path](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/#path)), contact
- [Mechanical](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/): 16-wheel rover, senior design project, lead CAD designer; 115-occurrence Fusion 360 assembly (14 unique parts), one central motor drives all 16 wheels via a TPU belt network; generative-design bogie arm 0.086 kg, min. safety factor 2.3, max. displacement 2.6 mm; 3D-printed parts; internship work (production-ready SolidWorks models and drawings from field measurements)
  - [#rover](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/#rover) the rover story · [#system](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/#system) the machine part by part · [#gd](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/#gd) eight generative-design candidates · [#iter](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/#iter) arm iterations · [#hand](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/#hand) a modeled bolt and the real part · [#internships](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechanical/#internships) internships
- [Mechatronics](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/): Ortam Aurora v2, ESP32-S3 smart room monitor; 4 sensors + OLED (temperature, humidity, light, air quality, sound), BLE (4-characteristic GATT) + Wi-Fi WebSocket/REST and a built-in web dashboard, 60-LED WS2812B sunrise alarm with a 30-minute ramp; v2 firmware hardened, independent review passed, flashed on hardware; phone app: v1 companion app (separate Flutter project), v2 app update for the token/PIN in progress; breadboard wiring drawing; origin: Arduino Uno + HC-SR04 proximity prototype planned in Tinkercad; Super Fulffy, a soil-moisture plant-watering design in Tinkercad (simulation only, no physical build)
  - [#ortam](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#ortam) Ortam Aurora in action (videos) · [#flow](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#flow) firmware as a diagram · [#wiring](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#wiring) wiring drawing and the real build · [#origin](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#origin) proximity-alert origin · [#final](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#final) final build with propeller fan · [#plant](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#plant) Super Fulffy plant watering (Tinkercad) · [#servo](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/mechatronics/#servo) servo-follow build (tested)
- [Software & AI](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/): method: spec → failing test → AI agent implements (planner ≠ implementer) → quality gate (lint, types, tests, coverage, mutation where a tool exists) → merge only on green; same gate across 7 project repositories (6 distinct codebases); "toothless" tests 45 → 14 in one repository; apps: Sesli Kitap (PDF → narrated Turkish audio, voice discussion, quizzes and a private-lesson mode, 1,500+ tests, 100% line-coverage gate on business logic), live TR → EN voice translation (Gemini), habit coach (Flutter + AI coach), Quant Engine (paper-trading research platform on real Binance and Yahoo Finance data, drawdown kill switch, no path to a real exchange), AlphaPulse (financial-intelligence terminal: news feed with AI analysis, portfolio and risk, four-agent strategy debate, compliance centre; React + Express + TypeScript; demo build on mock data, no API key needed)
  - [#method](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#method) the loop · [#gate](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#gate) roles and gate stages · [#toothless](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#toothless) toothless-test detector · [#apps](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#apps) app index · [#sesli-kitap](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#sesli-kitap) · [#translate](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#translate) · [#habit](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#habit) · [#quant](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#quant) · [#alphapulse](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#alphapulse) · [#how](https://alpserkanmerkit.github.io/software-ai/#how) three rules
